_full_body: If you would like to respond to this notification, please place your response above the dotted line. We want to clarify that the events in the North Clubhouse have been canceled due to the air conditioners being turned off. We have identified condensation from the air conditioning ductwork that is affecting the ceiling area near the restrooms. Our investigation revealed that the disconnect switch on the unit currently being replaced was inadvertently turned to the on position, which we believe contributed to this issue. Please be assured that this is not a roof leak. The recent rainy weather initially made diagnosis more challenging, but we have now identified the source. While the ceiling has sustained water damage, it remains structurally sound and poses no safety risk. We are addressing both the mechanical issue and the cosmetic repairs. We appreciate your patience and understanding as we work to resolve this matter promptly. We will notify you as soon as the North Clubhouse is available for events again. If you have any questions or concerns, please don't hestiate to contact the office. Sincerely, Resource Property Management, Inc. on behalf of Home Owners of Palm Hill, Inc (727) 581-2662 | www.resourcepropertymgmt.com
